strata.inclusion_rule: first eligible row per distinct prompt after discovery exclusions, until 32 rows
strata.provenance: frozen Qwen rollout records imported before confirmation scoring

randomness_contract.coupling: identical frozen prompt/response tensors, model state, optimizer initialization and deterministic execution repeats
